facts.text: In mid-July the stretch past White Pass to the high camp near 6,600 ft has several unexpected dips and re-climbs of a couple hundred feet, adding time to the day.
In mid-July the first rocky section above the glacier edge can be climbed unroped, and staying on rock keeps you above the worst crevassed ground before roping up.

notes: Every summited trailhead track also visits Glacier Peak or White Mountain, so none qualifies. Reports mostly cover the Glacier Peak combination.
